releases.body:
## What's Changed

### Bug Fixes

- **tools**: stop teaching the removed background argument in runtime strings
- **hooks,plan-contract**: drop background argument from injected strings
- **subagent-policy**: strip removed background argument at tool boundary

### Refactoring

- **delegation**: remove legacy task() syntax from canonical sources

### Documentation

- drop background argument claims across docs and AGENTS.md
- **skills**: rewrite delegation prompts onto async rendezvous doctrine
- **agents**: rewrite delegation prompts onto async rendezvous doctrine

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #105 from klpanagi/fix/background-subagents-v2
- Merge pull request #104 from klpanagi/fix/audit-consistency-2
- perf(skills): exclude matrixx-self-config from all agents by default

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2

## What's Changed

### Bug Fixes

- **consistency**: align prompts, skills, hooks, and tests with the code
- **config**: register all commands and retire dead hook names
- **agents,skills**: align prompts with native-subagent reality

### Refactoring

- **config**: remove inert task-toast-manager and subagent_block

### Documentation

- correct stale counts, paths, tool names, and wiring claims
- reconcile documentation with the native-subagent migration

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #103 from klpanagi/fix/audit-consistency-2
- Merge pull request #102 from klpanagi/chore/remove-inert-subsystems
- Merge pull request #101 from klpanagi/fix/audit-findings

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1

## What's Changed

### Features

- **cutover**: enable native subagent coexistence
- **tools**: thin subagent cancel+wait
- **policy**: subagent execute.before transformer
- **agents**: register per-category subagents

### Bug Fixes

- **policy**: omit unresolvable subagent model
- **registry**: mouse-* workers inherit their category model
- **agents**: register mouse-* model requirements

### Refactoring

- **effort**: ancestry-based attribution
- **bdd**: use native subagent APIs
- **assembly**: use native subagent APIs
- **commands**: migrate templates to native subagent
- **agents**: migrate prompts to native subagent

### Documentation

- native subagent final docs + schema
- **migration**: native subagent notes

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #100 from klpanagi/feat/native-subagent-migration
- BREAKING CHANGE: remove background-agent + obsolete hooks
- BREAKING CHANGE: remove custom task delegation

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.3.4...v1.4.0

## What's Changed

### Features

- **dcp**: wire keyword trigger into compress watchdog
- **policy**: keyword-triggered compress directive decision
- **cli**: write agents sibling file and add migration helper
- **config**: attach agents/categories sibling file per scope in plugin-config
- **config**: add agents file loader with deep-merge precedence
- **config**: add agents_file pointer schema and deprecate inline agents/categories
- **cli**: write presets sibling file and add migration helper
- **config**: extract model presets to matrixx.presets.jsonc sibling file
- **effort**: plan-level effort rollup, estimates, variance and surfacing

### Bug Fixes

- **titles**: bare session.create titles, labeled metadata only
- **tools**: register hashline edit, grep and glob as direct tools

### Documentation

- **config**: document agents_file sibling extraction

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #99 from klpanagi/feat/dcp-compress-keyword-trigger
- Merge pull request #98 from klpanagi/feat/agents-extract-file
- Merge pull request #97 from klpanagi/feat/presets-extract-file
- Merge pull request #96 from klpanagi/feat/plan-level-effort
- Merge pull request #95 from klpanagi/fix/subagent-title-double-prefix
- Merge pull request #93 from klpanagi/fix/direct-tool-registration-options
- Merge pull request #92 from klpanagi/chore/remove-evolution-module

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.3.3...v1.3.4

## What's Changed

### Features

- **config**: deprecate inert background_task keys without removing them
- **background-agent**: record failure history for compaction context
- **background-agent**: gate active-launch dedupe behind opt-in flag
- **background-agent**: restore re-acquisition behind opt-in flag
- **background-agent**: seed handle liveness and project progress writes
- **background-agent**: extend handle schema with origin, liveness and result fields
- **effort**: resolve task attribution for completion runs
- **effort**: record effort on foreground sync completions
- **effort**: record effort on background task completion
- **config**: add effort configuration schema and docs
- **effort**: add effort persistence and reporting
- **effort**: add effort calculator and recursive rollup
- **effort**: add effort types, constants, and telemetry collector

### Bug Fixes

- **background-task**: scope result cursor per task instead of per session
- **delegate-task**: replace unregister arity sniff with registry-state backstop
- **delegate-task**: guard unstable poll against active children
- **delegate-task**: cap nested delegation at depth 1
- **background-task**: drop stale concurrency-slot wording from queue note
- **background-task**: report original status when cancelling a task
- **background-task**: unify message time ordering and session ID placeholder
- **background-task**: wake block loop on task settle and cap output budget
- **background-agent**: gate stale finalizes to a single parent notification
- **background-agent**: restore toasts for live tasks on restart
- **background-agent**: key session-list cache by project directory
- **background-agent**: classify resolved foreign sessions and log resolveAny fallthrough
- **delegate-task**: enforce continuation task ownership and reject raw session ids
- **background-agent**: validate launch parent before creating a task
- **background-agent**: bound knownSessions to KNOWN_SESSIONS_MAX
- **background-agent**: wake waiters on sibling cancel instead of rejecting
- **background-agent**: rehydrate wall-clock deadline on restore
- **background-agent**: keep live handles during TTL sweep
- **background-agent**: stamp event-time lastActivityAt on handled events
- **background-agent**: notify parent on background_cancel
- **background-agent**: wire output guard into both completed transitions
- **background-agent**: gate uncovered auto-track on persisted delegation origin
- **background-agent**: suppress auto-track when the session is already covered
- **background-agent**: reindex session map on lazy sessionID assignment

### Refactoring

- **delegate-task**: drop dead defaultDirectory/parentDirectory/hasPendingParentWake params
- **background-agent**: delete dead fields with their readers
- **background-agent**: drop stale/expired terminal reasons and narrow on restore
- **background-agent**: delete dead wallclock and job-board members
- **background-agent**: delete dead modules and state re-export
- **hooks**: unwire unstable-agent-babysitter hook
- **background-agent**: add behaviour-neutral terminal finalizer

### Documentation

- **background-agent**: correct stale remediation claims

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #91 from klpanagi/docs/bg-remediation-closeout
- merge dev into PR-4 branch
- Merge pull request #90 from klpanagi/chore/bg-dead-code-removal
- Merge pull request #89 from klpanagi/fix/bg-tool-contract
- Merge pull request #88 from klpanagi/fix/bg-concurrency-routing
- Merge pull request #87 from klpanagi/fix/bg-notification-correctness
- Merge pull request #86 from klpanagi/feat/bg-handle-substrate
- Merge pull request #85 from klpanagi/chore/bg-remediation-harness
- Merge pull request #84 from klpanagi/feat/fix-bg-session-index
- Merge pull request #83 from klpanagi/feat/agent-effort-metric

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.3.2...v1.3.3
